compact_tables.description:
Omit default/redundant cell fields in table output (value when equal to raw, null
formulas, unit spans). Smaller results for large delimited files; consumers treat a
missing `value` as the raw string.

result_format.description:
Default representation of this job's result: `json` (canonical), `markdown` or
`text`. `GET .../result` uses it when no `?format=` query is given, so a job can be
requested in the form that will be shipped downstream (for example to object storage).

callback_url.description: Optional http(s) URL notified when the job reaches a terminal state (signed when webhook_secret is set)

202.description: Upload one file and JSON options

post.summary: Upload one file and JSON options

parameters.name: units

parameters.description: Export format; defaults to the job's result_format option
parameters.name: format

parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Maximum table rows in the slice (default 500, max 10000)
parameters.name: count
